short: Mid-name subword of rare proper names
notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Very sparse + pole (0.007% above 0.3 max); top examples are the 2nd+ token of a rare proper name (E-DF, Esh-el, Eh-ley, Ang-lia) plus odd cases like /licenses and hyper-ker-atosis, so it looks like a mid-word fragment detector with an E-name bias. Label is a hedge over a mixed bag; the near misses use common, single-token names.
